name: tep
description: Codex integration guidance for the TEP fact-memory server.

interface.shortDescription: Use the TEP server for durable facts, compact briefings, and argument checks.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex agents to use Trust Evidence Protocol as a server-backed fact memory: ingest user input and documents as sources, learn reusable CLM facts with quotes, retrieve compact fact cards by tag or query, relate facts, create aggregate facts, capture command runs, and check reasoning chains before finalizing.
defaultPrompt: Start a TEP session and brief me on the relevant facts for this task.
Ingest this input as a TEP source and extract quote-backed CLM facts.
Check this reasoning chain against TEP facts before finalizing.
